about: Mods used in builds that have been read, one record per build and the player who made it. Seeded 2026-10-09 with the top 100 builds in each of Overframe's six categories (warframes, primary, secondary, melee, archwing, companions). Add every build read from now on with tools/mod_usage.py add. A mod's popularity is the number of DIFFERENT players using it.
